hero.title: The commercial bridge between Italian industry and East Africa

hero.imageAlt: Industrial engineer in a hard hat holding a tablet on a factory floor

process.title: Six stages from requirement to operation
process.intro: Scroll the strip. Each frame is one stage of a deal, from the first qualified buyer to the machine running on site.

steps.title: Buyer Identification & Qualification
steps.text: We identify East African manufacturers with genuine equipment requirements and verify their purchasing capacity and project timelines.

steps.title: Needs Assessment
steps.text: A detailed technical assessment of the buyer's specifications, production volumes and operational constraints.

steps.title: Manufacturer Matching
steps.text: We match the qualified requirement to the right Italian manufacturer from our verified network.

steps.title: Negotiation & Deal Structuring
steps.text: Price, commercial terms, payment structures and contract conditions, managed for both parties.

steps.title: Logistics & Customs Coordination
steps.text: Freight, documentation and customs clearance from the Italian factory to the buyer's facility.

steps.title: After-Sales Support
steps.text: The single local point of accountability for installation, spare parts, technical queries and service.
